scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: bun run db:start && DB_URI=${DB_URI:-postgresql://beamos:beamos@${DB_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:${DB_PORT:-5432}/beamos} PORT=${PORT:-3001} bun --env-file=../../.env run --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.build: bun run lint && bun run --cwd packages/openapi-client build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run lint && bun run --cwd packages/openapi-client typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd apps/api test:unit && bun run --cwd apps/web test:unit
